links.outcome: Expert clinician review of sampled real AI outputs for clinical appropriateness
links.effect: Expert review rated 99 of 100 sampled outputs as clinically appropriate; no adverse events detected.
links.quote: No adverse events were detected, and expert review rated 99 of 100 sampled outputs as clinically appropriate.

links.outcome: Prospective limited pilot of AI decision support: safety, usability, adoption, length of stay, consultation cycle time
links.effect: No adverse events; adoption declined from 68% to 30%; ED length of stay 4.9 h in both wings (P=0.99); consultation time -9.4 min, P=0.077.
links.quote: Emergency department length of stay did not differ between wings (4.9 h in both, P = 0.99).

links.outcome: Clinician adoption of AI tool over time and relation to workload
links.effect: Adoption declined from 68% to 30%, with workload-sensitive disengagement (OR = 0.72 per shift hour, 95% CI 0.62 to 0.83).
links.quote: Clinical adoption of SHAKED declined from 68% to 30%, owing to workload-sensitive disengagement (OR = 0.72 per shift hour, 95% CI 0.62 to 0.83).

screen.reason: Prospective DECIDE-AI stage 1 evaluation of an LLM-based clinical decision support tool deployed in an emergency department, measuring clinician adoption, appropriateness, and operational outcomes.
